finding.claim: _apm_hooks_data catches only JSONDecodeError, so a .agents/hooks.json that is not valid UTF-8 raises UnicodeDecodeError and crashes kmctl doctor and kmctl plugin install instead of taking the 'not a JSON object' repair path. This was already true before the change.

fixes.change: _apm_hooks_data also catches UnicodeDecodeError, so a hooks.json that is not UTF-8 takes the repair path instead of crashing doctor and install.
The unparsable-file test also runs on a JSON list and on bytes that are not UTF-8.
